Katseye in Singapore, 10 Feb 2027: First Concert at the Indoor Stadium, Presales From 10 Nov and General Sale 13 Nov | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 News Katseye in Singapore, 10 Feb 2027: First Concert at the Indoor Stadium, Presales From 10 Nov and General Sale 13 Nov
 Live Nation has confirmed KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR for Singapore, one night at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on Wednesday 10 February 2027. It is the HYBE x Geffen girl group's first concert here. Tickets go through Ticketmaster Singapore in five waves: the EYEKONS membership presale on Tuesday 10 November at noon, the UOB Mastercard World Elite presale on Wednesday 11 November at noon, the wider UOB Mastercard presale at 4pm the same day, the KATSEYE.WORLD artist presale on Thursday 12 November at 2pm, and the general sale on Friday 13 November at 10am. Ticket prices and the show time have not been published yet, so the main job now is to sort out which presale you qualify for, a UOB Mastercard or a fan membership, before 10 November.
 Marcus Wong 29 October 2026 4 min read KATSEYE are playing Singapore for the first time. Live Nation has confirmed KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on Wednesday 10 February 2027 , one night only, with tickets on Ticketmaster Singapore. 
 > Quick view: presales run 10 to 12 November , the general sale opens Friday 13 November at 10am . Ticket prices and the show time are not out yet . VIP packages are sold separately on the KATSEYE Weverse Shop. 
 The on-sale order 
 Five windows, all start times as listed on the Live Nation Singapore event page: 
 Window Opens 
 EYEKONS Membership Presale Tue 10 Nov 2026, 12pm 
 UOB Mastercard World Elite Presale Wed 11 Nov 2026, 12pm 
 UOB Mastercard Presale Wed 11 Nov 2026, 4pm 
 KATSEYE.WORLD Artist Presale Thu 12 Nov 2026, 2pm 
 General Sale (and UOB Mastercard World & World Elite Preferred) Fri 13 Nov 2026, 10am 
 Ticketing is via ticketmaster.sg . Sign in to your Ticketmaster account before your window opens rather than on the hour, since big K-pop and pop on-sales here usually run through a queue. 
 What is not announced yet 
 Prices. No tiers or seat map were published on 29 October. Expect them before the 10 November presale. 
 Show time. Only the date is confirmed. 
 VIP inclusions. Live Nation says VIP experiences for the Asia, Australia and New Zealand legs will be sold through the KATSEYE Weverse Shop , starting with the general sale on 13 November at 10am. What each package includes was not listed. 
 What it means for you 
 The two earliest routes are fan memberships (EYEKONS on 10 Nov, KATSEYE.WORLD on 12 Nov) and the two middle ones are for UOB Mastercard holders. If you hold none of these, 13 November at 10am is your window, so plan around a Friday morning. A Wednesday-night show also means a work or school night: worth sorting leave or transport early, and the Indoor Stadium is a short walk from Stadium MRT. 
 The tour has been selling out across Europe and North America, and Singapore is one of a handful of newly added Asian stops alongside Yokohama, Manila, Hong Kong, Seoul, Cebu, Bangkok and Taipei, so expect demand from overseas fans too. 
 *Photo: official KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR visual, Live Nation Singapore. Dates and on-sale windows verified from the livenation.sg event page on 29 October 2026.*

 Frequently Asked Questions
 When do Katseye Singapore tickets go on sale? + The general sale opens on Friday 13 November 2026 at 10am on Ticketmaster Singapore. Before that there are four presales: EYEKONS membership on Tuesday 10 November at 12pm, UOB Mastercard World Elite on Wednesday 11 November at 12pm, UOB Mastercard on Wednesday 11 November at 4pm, and the KATSEYE.WORLD artist presale on Thursday 12 November at 2pm. A UOB Mastercard World & World Elite Preferred window opens at the same time as the general sale.
 How much are Katseye concert tickets in Singapore? + Prices have not been published yet. Neither the Live Nation Singapore event page nor the announcement lists a price on 29 October 2026. They are normally released before the first presale, so check the Live Nation or Ticketmaster page in the days before 10 November. VIP experience packages are sold separately through the KATSEYE Weverse Shop from the 13 November general sale.
 Do I need a UOB card to get Katseye tickets early? + Not necessarily. Two of the four presales are for UOB Mastercard holders (World Elite on 11 Nov at noon, then the wider UOB Mastercard presale at 4pm), but the EYEKONS membership presale on 10 Nov and the KATSEYE.WORLD artist presale on 12 Nov are fan routes that do not depend on a bank card. If you have none of these, the general sale on 13 Nov at 10am is open to everyone with a Ticketmaster account.
